description: This file defines the OneShotAlarm class, which extends BroadcastReceiver and handles a one-time alarm event by displaying a Toast message.

classes.name: OneShotAlarm
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that responds to an alarm event by showing a toast message.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Called when the alarm broadcasts, shows a toast message indicating the alarm was received.
